answer: Special Ops field rule: pay each identity its marginal value, not a seat fee. Each epoch the network replays its grading and attestation over random subsets of agents, with and without each one, and pays by the Shapley average of how much that agent moved the outcome. A clone that grades like its twins changes nothing when dropped, so a hundred copies split near zero. To earn, every fake must add signal no sibling already carries, which means real independent work. By dawn the ledger shows who mattered; the umber haze of echoes fades and only distinct voices reach the summit.
